Claim BetScarab Casino bonus from your very first deposits! Choose from four welcome packages covering casino games, larger VIP deposits, cryptocurrency payments and sports betting. Start with the Casino Welcome Pack offering 444% up to €14,000 and 444 free spins, or select the package that matches your preferred games.

After completing your welcome package, you can unlock eight Weekly Reload bonuses, including two Friday offers. Each promotion comes with its own deposit requirements, wagering conditions, betting limits and expiry periods. Explore the rewards, choose your bonus and get started.

BetScarab Welcome Bonuses

We've prepared four welcome packages with different rewards. The Casino Welcome Pack combines deposit bonuses with free spins, while the VIP Welcome Pack focuses on larger deposit bonuses. The Crypto Welcome Bonus rewards your first cryptocurrency deposit, and the Sport Welcome Pack provides FreeBets for football accumulators.

The Casino Welcome Pack covers five deposits, while the VIP Welcome Pack and Sport Welcome Pack each include three stages. Our cryptocurrency offer applies to your first qualifying crypto deposit. You can have one active bonus at a time, and welcome package stages are completed in order.

Casino Welcome Pack - 444% up to €14,000 + 444 FS

Start with the Casino Welcome Pack and collect rewards across your first five deposits. We've combined 444% up to €14,000 with 444 free spins, giving you a separate bonus and free spin allocation at every stage.

Crypto Welcome Bonus - 110% up to 1,100 USDT + 110 FS

Make your first cryptocurrency deposit and claim 110% up to 1,100 USDT, along with 110 free spins on Bonanza Trillion. Deposit at least 30 USDT using a supported cryptocurrency payment method to activate the offer.

Sport Welcome Pack - 150% FreeBet up to €115

We've created the Sport Welcome Pack for football betting, with 150% in FreeBets worth up to €115 across three deposits. Claim 50% up to €30 on your first deposit, 50% up to €40 on your second and 50% up to €45 on your third.

Use your FreeBets on football accumulators containing two or three selections. Eligible competitions include the Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, UEFA Champions League, UEFA Europa League, UEFA Conference League and major international national team competitions.

Each event must have odds between 8.00 and 20.00. We accept FreeBets on pre-match markets only, and the first event in your accumulator must start within seven days of placing the bet. Singles, system bets, live betting, friendlies, youth competitions, lower divisions and regional leagues are excluded.

We pay FreeBet winnings directly into your real-money balance without wagering requirements. Your winnings are calculated as FreeBet stake × (total accumulator odds − 1). The original FreeBet stake is not included in the payout.

Weekly Reload Bonuses

How to Activate a BetScarab Bonus

Open Promotions to explore our available bonuses and select the package you want to claim. Multi-stage welcome offers include Bonus Steps, where you can see the rewards linked to each deposit.

To activate your bonus:

  1. Sign in to your account at BetScarab Casino and open Promotions.

  2. Choose your welcome package or an available Weekly Reload.

  3. Make a qualifying deposit using an eligible payment method.

  4. Activate the bonus and check your reward in your account.

Complete your personal details, verify your email address and accept the promotion's terms before claiming your reward. You don't need a promo code for our welcome packages. For the Crypto Welcome Bonus, we credit the free spins automatically after the qualifying deposit.

You can have only one active bonus at a time. Finish or cancel your current bonus before activating another offer. Welcome package rewards follow their deposit order and cannot be combined into one stage.

Minimum Deposits for BetScarab Bonuses

Our Casino Welcome Pack and Sport Welcome Pack both start at €50. The VIP Welcome Pack requires a minimum deposit of €400, while the Crypto Welcome Bonus starts at 30 USDT. Your reward is calculated using the deposit amount, bonus percentage and maximum limit for the relevant stage.

Most Weekly Reloads start at €20. Thursday's Reload and Friday Exclusive require €50. Deposits below the qualifying amount do not activate the corresponding bonus.

Wagering Requirements and Game Contributions

Our Casino Welcome Pack, VIP Welcome Pack and Crypto Welcome Bonus carry wagering requirements of x40 the bonus amount. Winnings from free spins also have x40 wagering. Complete the required betting volume before transferring eligible bonus winnings into your Cash Balance.

For example, a €100 bonus with x40 wagering requires €4,000 in qualifying bets. We calculate wagering from the bonus amount alone, not from the combined value of your deposit and bonus.

Different games contribute different percentages towards your wagering progress. Regular slots without bonus features contribute 100%, while slots with bonus features contribute 50%. Roulette and blackjack, including their live dealer versions, contribute 10%. Crash, Casual and Mines games contribute 5%.

Poker, video poker, other card games, virtual sports, lotteries, scratch cards, Craps, Fishing and game shows contribute 0%. Bets placed on these games do not count towards bonus wagering. We also exclude certain games from specific promotions, so check the Bonus Wagering section before choosing where to play with bonus funds.

We use funds from your Cash Balance first. Once your real-money balance has been depleted, bets are taken from your Bonus Balance. After you complete the wagering requirement, we transfer eligible remaining bonus funds to your Cash Balance, applying the winnings limits for your promotion.

Maximum Bets and Winnings Limits

When playing with an active Casino Welcome Pack, VIP Welcome Pack or Crypto Welcome Bonus, your maximum bet is €5 per round. This restriction applies until you've completed the bonus requirements. Bets above the limit breach the promotion's conditions and can result in the loss of your bonus and associated winnings.

For the Casino Welcome Pack, you can withdraw bonus winnings of up to 10 times the bonus amount. If you receive a €100 bonus, for example, the maximum withdrawal from winnings linked to that bonus is €1,000.

The VIP Welcome Pack has separate limits for each deposit stage. The first bonus has a maximum withdrawal of 3x its value, while the second and third bonuses have a 5x limit. For the Crypto Welcome Bonus, the maximum withdrawal from bonus winnings is 10x the bonus received.

We cap free spin winnings from the Casino Welcome Pack and Crypto Welcome Bonus at €1,000. For the Casino Welcome Pack, the maximum withdrawal from free spin winnings is also limited to 2x the winnings received.

Sport Welcome Pack FreeBets follow separate betting restrictions. They can only be used on eligible football competitions and qualifying pre-match accumulators, with no additional wagering on winnings.

Bonus and Free Spin Expiry

You have seven days from activation to complete wagering for the Casino Welcome Pack, VIP Welcome Pack and Crypto Welcome Bonus. Any outstanding bonus balance and associated winnings are forfeited if you don't complete the requirements within this period.

Free spin winnings have their own seven-day wagering deadline, beginning when we credit them to your account. The spins themselves follow the expiry conditions assigned to the relevant game and promotion.

Activate your VIP Welcome Pack bonus within seven days of receiving it. Sport Welcome Pack FreeBets also expire seven days after being credited, so place your qualifying accumulator before the deadline.

Our welcome packages have no fixed campaign end date. We may change or discontinue promotions, and the terms in effect when you activate an offer apply to your participation.

Checking Your Active Bonus and Bonus Balance

We keep real-money and bonus funds separate in your account. Your Cash Balance contains your real-money funds, while your Bonus Balance holds the funds linked to your active promotion. This allows you to keep track of your available balance during bonus play.

Open My bonuses to check your active rewards, manage your bonus and follow your wagering progress. For multi-stage welcome packages, Bonus Steps also shows your deposit stages and the rewards assigned to each one.

After completing wagering, we move your eligible remaining bonus funds to your Cash Balance. Any maximum winnings or withdrawal limits attached to the promotion are applied before the transfer.

Why a Bonus May Be Unavailable or Cancelled

A bonus won't activate if you haven't met its requirements. This includes making a deposit below the minimum amount, trying to claim a welcome stage you've already used or having another active bonus in your account. Complete your personal details, verify your email address and accept the promotion's terms to participate.

You can cancel an active bonus in My bonuses or contact our support team for assistance. Cancelling forfeits the bonus funds and all associated winnings. We don't transfer unused bonus funds into your real-money balance when a bonus is cancelled.

Submitting a withdrawal request before using your bonus or while it remains active also forfeits the bonus and associated winnings. This applies to our deposit welcome packages and Sport Welcome Pack FreeBets.

We may withhold or cancel bonuses and associated winnings when our promotion rules are breached. This includes exceeding the maximum bet, using multiple accounts, submitting false account details or attempting to abuse our bonus offers.

BetScarab Casino Slots

Choose traditional reels with fruit symbols and sevens, games with bonus rounds or modern slots featuring Hold and Win, Megaways and other special features. We've organised the collection into categories including Top, New, Trending Games, Buy Bonus and Bonus Wager.

We've also created Pharaoh Party, a collection inspired by ancient Egypt. Among the themed games are Sun of Egypt 3, 4 Pots of Egypt and Egypt's Sun. This dedicated section makes it easy to explore Egyptian-themed slots without searching through the entire lobby.

Popular Slots and Trending Games

Our Top and Trending Games sections bring together popular titles from across the lobby. You'll find Wanted Dead or a Wild with its Wild West theme, alongside Fortune Tiger, Mahjong Ways 2 and Supercharged Clovers: Hold and Win. Browse these collections to discover player favourites and explore different styles of slot gameplay.

If you enjoy slots with additional features, take a look at Lion Gems 3 Pots: Hold and Win and Elephant's Gold: Bonus Combo. Their bonus mechanics add extra possibilities to standard spins, while special symbols can trigger additional rounds. Each game has its own winning combinations, payout structure and bonus features.

You'll also find games with classic symbols, such as 3 Hot Chillies, and slots with more modern mechanics, including Fist of Destruction. Search for a particular title or browse the collections to discover other games in a similar style.

New Slots

We regularly add new releases from game studios to our New section. Explore fresh themes, different bonus features and a variety of gaming formats. Titles featured in this collection include Charge Bison Ascent, Frog Dash 10000 and Grand Golden Treasure.

New arrivals aren't limited to traditional slots. The New section also includes other game formats, such as Mines football, Cash Balloon and Bingo Empire. We bring these titles together so you can discover recent additions beyond standard reel-based games.

To find a particular game, enter its name in the search bar. If you'd rather explore releases from your favourite studio, select it in the Providers section.

Buy Bonus Slots

Buy Bonus lets you access a special bonus round without waiting for it to trigger during regular spins. Selected slots offer this feature at a fixed purchase price determined by the game. Buying a bonus round doesn't guarantee a win, and its cost can be considerably higher than a standard spin.

We've brought games with this option together in a dedicated category. Available titles include ClawBass Bonanza, 3 Pigs of Olympus Bonus Pot, Wild Buffalo: Fortune Wheel Bonus Buy and #buyBonus of Maya. You can also explore Aztec Magic Megaways, Book of Panda Megaways and 40 Sevens - Buy Feature.

If you enjoy bonus mechanics involving coins and special symbols, try Coins of Ra Power - Hold & Win, 3 Coin Volcanoes or The Tipsy Tourist: Beach Bonanza - Hold & Win. Features vary between games and include free spins, special symbols and separate bonus rounds.

Before purchasing a bonus feature, check its price and the slot's rules. Buying bonus rounds may be restricted while certain casino promotions are active. We explain these restrictions and other wagering conditions on our BetScarab bonuses page.

Bonus Wager Games

Our Bonus Wager category brings together games associated with bonus funds and wagering requirements. Open this section while using an active bonus to explore the available titles and find games that suit your preferred style.

The collection includes Snoop Dogg Dollars, Diamond of Jungle, Fortune Garuda 500, Coin Reel: Hold to Win, The Great Icescape and Max Elements GigaBlox. You'll also find other gaming formats, including Turbo Plinko, Triple Strike Poker and selected blackjack and roulette games.

Games in Bonus Wager don't all contribute equally towards wagering requirements. Regular slots, games with bonus features, table games and other categories have different contribution rates. For example, a game can accept bonus-funded bets while only a percentage of each stake counts towards wagering progress.

Jackpot Slots

Our Jackpots category brings together slots with jackpot features and other games offering additional prizes. Among the available titles are 777 Jackpot Diamond Hold and Win, Super Fire Jackpot, Frost Queen Jackpots and Coin Craze Jackpot.

Some games combine jackpot prizes with Hold and Win features, including Amazonia Jackpot Hold and Win and 777 Jackpot Diamond Hold and Win Deluxe. Others feature their own bonus rounds or special prize mechanics. The category also includes Jackpot Mines, Jackpot Bingo and Jackpot Fishing, extending the selection beyond traditional reel-based slots.

Jackpot games can feature fixed or progressive prizes. A fixed jackpot has a predetermined amount, while a progressive jackpot grows according to the game's rules. Prize values, qualifying stakes and jackpot triggers differ between titles and providers.

We also run a separate €1,000,000 jackpot event featured on the BetScarab Casino homepage. This promotion has its own participation rules and operates separately from the jackpot features built into individual games.

BetScarab Live Casino

Our Live Casino brings you games hosted by real dealers at live tables. Watch the action unfold, place your bets and follow the results as each round takes place. Choose from roulette, blackjack, baccarat, Dragon Tiger and live game shows.

We've divided the Live Casino into Live Games, Roulette, Blackjack, Baccarat and Game Shows. Browse the main collection to explore different tables or choose a specific category to find your preferred game. Featured titles include Royal Roulette, Monaco Blackjack VIP, Grand Bonus Baccarat and Speed Blackjack.

Live Dealer Roulette

Our Live Casino includes roulette tables with different betting formats and game speeds. Choose from Venice Roulette, Gravity Roulette, Royal Roulette and Roulette Lite. You'll also find Hanguk Auto Roulette, Cricket Roulette and Auto Roulette.

Alongside traditional versions, we offer tables with special multipliers and additional features, including Auto Roulette 500X and Bar Roulette 2000x. These formats introduce enhanced payout possibilities through special multipliers and game-specific features.

Explore traditional roulette, automated tables and versions with additional prize mechanics. Each table has its own betting range, available options and payout rules, so you can select a format that matches your preferences.

Blackjack and Card Games

Our Blackjack category includes a variety of live dealer tables. Available titles include Speed Blackjack, Monaco Blackjack, Luxe Blackjack, Oasis VIP Blackjack and Royal Private Blackjack. Choose traditional tables, faster rounds or VIP formats with their own betting limits.

Before joining a table, check the minimum and maximum stakes, available gameplay options and rules for that particular version.

For other card games, we offer baccarat, Dragon Tiger and poker titles. The Baccarat section includes Grand Bonus Baccarat, Tao Yuan Baccarat, Shangrila Baccarat and VIP Baccarat. Choose between Player, Banker and Tie bets across different tables and betting ranges.

Dragon Tiger adds another format to our live card game collection, while poker titles offer different combinations of betting decisions and gameplay. You can explore additional card games in our Table Games section.

Live Game Shows

Our live game shows combine betting with a television-style entertainment format. Instead of traditional card tables, these games feature wheels, special playing areas and bonus rounds that add variety to each session.

Available titles include Wheel Of Fortune, Classic Wheel, Gravity Wheel and Adventures Beyond Wonderland Live. Each show introduces its own betting options, from wheel segments and spin outcomes to special features and bonus rounds.

You'll also find Crash Live and Sic Bo in our Game Shows category. These titles offer different round mechanics and ways of determining results. Open a game to explore its betting options, round structure and payout rules.

BetScarab Table Games

Alongside Live Casino, we have a dedicated Table Games collection featuring classic table games and digital versions of popular card games. Available titles include European Roulette, American Blackjack, Premium European Blackjack, Casino Hold 'Em and Andar Bahar.

For poker enthusiasts, we also offer Ultimate Texas Holdem, Triple Edge Poker and Bet On Poker. Our Poker category includes video poker titles such as Jacks or Better, Deuces Wild, Bonus Poker and Videopoker 3in1. Each game brings its own selection of poker hands, betting options and payout combinations.

Explore different roulette variations, blackjack formats and poker games without switching between separate sections of the casino. Traditional table games and digital versions offer different approaches to betting, with individual rules and stake ranges.

Use the search bar in our Table Games section to find a specific title. You can also browse the dedicated Poker and Live Casino categories to discover other versions of your favourite games.

pages.title: Login
pages.content:
Log in to your BetScarab Casino account using the email address and password you created during registration. The BetScarab Casino login form gives you access to your balance, profile settings, favourite games and sports betting. Your account works across both casino and sportsbook, so there's no need to sign in separately.

We've made it easy to access your account and recover a forgotten password. Use our LOG IN form to sign in, reset your password by email or contact our support team if your account has been restricted. We also protect account access with identity checks and security measures designed to prevent unauthorised activity.

How to Log In to Your BetScarab Account

Open the LOG IN form on the BetScarab Casino website. To complete your BetScarab Casino login, enter your registered email address and password, then confirm your details. Both fields must match the information linked to your existing account.

To sign in:

  1. Open our website and click LOG IN.

  2. Enter your registered email address in the Email field.

  3. Type your password in the Password field.

  4. Click LOG IN to access your account.

Once you've completed your BetScarab login, you can manage your balance, open your account settings and continue playing with your existing profile. If you're new to BetScarab, click Register now below the login form to create an account.

How to Reset a Forgotten Password

Forgotten your password? Click Forgot your password? below the LOG IN button to open our Reset Password form. Enter the email address linked to your account and select Change Password. We'll send you an email with instructions for setting a new password.

Open the recovery email, follow the instructions and create your new password. You can then return to the LOG IN form and complete your BetScarab login using the updated details.

If the recovery email hasn't arrived, check your Spam or Junk folder and confirm that you've entered the correct email address. You can request password recovery without creating another account.

Common BetScarab login Problems

If your BetScarab Casino login isn't working, check your email address and password for typing errors. Make sure you're using the correct keyboard layout and haven't entered extra spaces. Click the eye icon in the Password field to view the characters you've typed.

If the LOG IN form isn't loading or doesn't respond, refresh the page and check your internet connection. You can also try opening our website in another browser to resolve temporary loading problems.

If your details are correct but the BetScarab login attempt still fails, reset your password using Forgot your password?. If the problem continues, contact our support team. We'll check your account access and help you resolve the issue.

Accessing a Restricted or Blocked Account

At BetScarab, we may temporarily restrict access to your account while confirming your identity, investigating suspicious activity or carrying out additional security checks. When an account is restricted, resetting the password doesn't automatically restore access.

Contact our support team if your account has been blocked. We'll review its status, explain the restriction and tell you what is needed to restore access. We may request an identity document or additional account details to confirm ownership before allowing another BetScarab login attempt.

Self Exclusion follows separate responsible gambling rules. If you've activated self-exclusion, changing your password won't remove the restriction. Your access remains limited for the applicable exclusion period.

Keeping Your BetScarab Account Secure

We protect account access and personal information with secure connections, identity verification and account security checks. The BetScarab Casino login process is covered by these measures, and we handle your personal details under our Privacy Policy. We also monitor suspicious activity to help prevent unauthorised access.

Keep your password private and don't share your BetScarab login details with anyone. If you use a shared or public device, sign out when you've finished and avoid saving your password in the browser.

If you notice unfamiliar activity in your BetScarab Casino account or suspect that someone else has obtained your password, contact our support team. We'll investigate the issue and help secure your account.

pages.title: Withdrawal
pages.content:
Withdraw your winnings from BetScarab Casino to a bank card, through Interac e-Transfer, Bank Transfer or cryptocurrency. We support Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, Solana and other digital assets. The minimum withdrawal amount is €80, while the maximum depends on your chosen payment method.

We process withdrawal requests within three working days. Before sending your funds, we check your balance, payment details and compliance with our financial requirements. Identity verification may be required for your first withdrawal or certain transactions. You can choose your preferred withdrawal method in the cashier and submit a request directly from your account.

Available Withdrawal Methods

We offer bank and cryptocurrency withdrawals with different maximum transaction amounts. Open the Withdrawal tab in the cashier to select your payment method, enter the amount and provide the necessary details. Each method has its own limits.

Payment method availability depends on your country and the services supported in your region. In the cashier, we display the withdrawal options available for your account, along with their minimum and maximum transaction amounts.

Interac e-Transfer

For withdrawals through Interac, we offer two payment options — Interac e-Transfer and Interac. Both operate through the banking payment network and allow you to receive funds in supported bank accounts.

Select Interac in the cashier, enter the required details and confirm your withdrawal request. Once we've processed it, the funds are transferred through the banking system. The time it takes for the money to arrive depends on your bank and any additional checks.

Bank Cards and Bank Transfer

We support withdrawals to Credit Card and through Bank Transfer. Card withdrawals are suitable for standard amounts, while Bank Transfer allows you to request larger payouts. When selecting your method, enter the amount, check your payment details and confirm the transaction.

Card withdrawals are subject to the issuing bank's rules. We accept supported personal bank cards but do not process withdrawals to corporate credit cards. If your bank declines an incoming payment, contact our support team for help resolving the issue.

Banks and payment intermediaries may charge fees for processing transfers or converting currencies. These charges are determined by the financial institution handling the payment.

Cryptocurrency Withdrawals — USDT, BTC, ETH, SOL, LTC, DOGE and TRX

Withdraw your winnings in USDT, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Litecoin, Dogecoin or Tron. We also support Bitcoin Cash and USD Coin. USDT withdrawals are available through two networks — TRC-20 and ERC-20 — which you can select when submitting your request.

Choose your cryptocurrency in the cashier, enter the amount and provide your wallet address. Check that you've selected the correct network and entered the correct address before confirming. USDT TRC-20 requires a wallet that supports the TRC-20 network, while ERC-20 requires a compatible Ethereum address.

Once we send your cryptocurrency, the transaction goes through blockchain confirmation. Processing speed depends on network activity. An incorrect wallet address or an incompatible network can result in the permanent loss of funds, so always check your payment details before submitting a request.

Minimum Withdrawal Amount

The minimum withdrawal amount is €80. Your account must have enough funds available for withdrawal before you can submit a request. If your balance is below this threshold, you'll need to wait until you have sufficient funds to withdraw.

Before processing a payout, we check that you've met the deposit turnover requirements. Regular deposits made without a bonus must be wagered at least once. For example, if you deposit €100, you must place €100 worth of bets before withdrawing those funds.

Funds linked to an active bonus have separate conditions. We explain wagering requirements, maximum bets and winnings limits on our BetScarab bonuses page.

Maximum Withdrawal Limits

Alongside individual transaction limits, we apply restrictions on the total amount you can withdraw within a given period. Daily, weekly and monthly limits determine how much you can receive during each period, regardless of the number of withdrawal requests submitted.

If your withdrawal amount exceeds the applicable limit, we may divide it into several payments. Large winnings may be paid in instalments over subsequent payment periods in accordance with our withdrawal limits.

We may arrange individual withdrawal conditions for players at higher VIP levels. These depend on your account status and are agreed separately. Contact our support team to confirm the limits applicable to your account.

How to Request a Withdrawal

You can request a withdrawal directly through the BetScarab Casino cashier. Before submitting your request, check your available balance and prepare your payment details. Bank withdrawals require your account or card information, while cryptocurrency withdrawals require a wallet address.

To withdraw your funds:

  1. Sign in to your account at BetScarab Casino and open the cashier.

  2. Select the Withdrawal tab.

  3. Choose your preferred bank or cryptocurrency withdrawal method.

  4. Enter an amount within the applicable limits.

  5. Provide your payment details and check that they're correct.

  6. Confirm your request and complete identity verification if required.

We check your available balance, payment details and compliance with our financial requirements. If additional documents are needed, we'll request them during the verification process.

Use only your own bank accounts, cards and payment methods to receive withdrawals. We do not process payments to third parties. The name on your payment method must match the details registered to your account.

Withdrawal Processing Times

We process withdrawal requests within three working days. During this period, we check the transaction's financial requirements, your available balance and payment details. Once these checks are complete, we send your funds through your chosen payment method.

The actual time it takes for funds to arrive depends on the withdrawal method. Bank transfers may require additional processing by the receiving bank or intermediary institutions. Cryptocurrency withdrawals require transaction confirmations on the relevant blockchain network.

If you need to complete KYC verification or provide additional documents before a withdrawal, the overall processing time may increase. We continue the verification process once we've received the required information and confirmed your payment details.

Identity and Payment Method Verification

We use Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures to confirm account ownership and verify financial transactions. Identity verification may be required before any withdrawal, regardless of its amount. We also carry out full verification when your total deposits exceed €2,000.

To verify your identity and payment details, we may request:

  • A government-issued photo ID, such as a passport, national ID card or another official identity document.

  • A selfie with your identity document to confirm account ownership.

  • Proof of address, such as a bank statement or utility bill.

  • Proof of ownership of the payment method used for deposits or withdrawals.

Your documents must be valid, clear and consistent with your account details. Your identity document must not expire within the next three months. If your document has information on both sides, we may request images of the front and back.

We carry out verification checks according to the risk level of each transaction. Our standard checks cover identity and basic payment details. For large or unusual transactions, we may request additional documents and conduct enhanced verification.

If your documents fail verification, we'll explain what needs to be corrected or submitted again. Withdrawals may remain restricted until verification is complete.

Reasons for Withdrawal Delays or Rejections

When processing your withdrawal request, we check your financial details and confirm that all withdrawal conditions have been met. If we identify an error or need additional confirmation, we may pause the transaction until the necessary checks are complete.

Delays most commonly occur because of incomplete verification, unreadable documents, incorrect payment details or unmet deposit turnover requirements. For example, if a document contains incomplete information, we'll ask you to upload it again. Incorrect cryptocurrency wallet details must also be corrected before the transaction is sent.

We carry out additional financial checks for unusual transactions, suspicious activity or inconsistencies in personal information. Breaching our payment rules may result in a rejected withdrawal and restrictions on financial transactions within your account.

Bank transfers can also be delayed while the financial institution processes the payment. If your bank rejects a transaction, we'll help you check its status and determine the next steps.

If your withdrawal is delayed, contact our support team with the amount, request date and selected payment method. We'll check the transaction and help resolve the issue.

Cancelling a Withdrawal Request

If you want to change the amount or payment details after submitting a withdrawal request, contact our support team. We'll check the transaction status and help cancel the request if the transfer hasn't been completed.

Once funds have been sent to a bank or payment provider, cancellation depends on the stage of processing. Completed cryptocurrency transactions cannot be cancelled or reversed through the cashier because they're confirmed directly on the blockchain.

Before submitting a new withdrawal request, check your available balance, withdrawal amount and recipient details. This helps prevent errors in your next transaction.
